EMAIL:
Subject: Our office is moving to Riverside House

Hello everyone,

Our team is moving from Station Road to Riverside House, 14 Canal Street. Our first working day there is Monday 7 December 2026.

Wednesday 2 December is our last day at Station Road. The office closes at 16:00. On Thursday 3 and Friday 4 December, everyone works from home while the movers pack and move the furniture.

What you need to do:
- Empty crates arrive at Station Road on Monday 30 November. You get two each.
- Pack your crates by 16:00 on Wednesday 2 December. Label them with your name and your team's zone.
- Do not pack monitors, docking stations or keyboards. IT will move them.
- Take your laptop and charger home on Wednesday 2 December.
- Book a desk in the DeskBook app from Monday 30 November. Choose your team's zone on floor 2 if you can.
- Collect your new access badge at reception from 08:00 on Monday 7 December. Bring photo ID.

Questions about the move? Email the move team at move-team@example.com.

Thanks,
The move team

CHAT:
Moving news! Our first day at Riverside House, 14 Canal Street, is Monday 7 Dec. Pack and label your two crates with your name and zone by 16:00 on Wed 2 Dec. Take your laptop and charger home that day. We work from home Thu 3 and Fri 4 Dec. Questions: move-team@example.com

FAQ:
Q: When and where do we move?
A: We move to Riverside House, 14 Canal Street. Your first working day there is Monday 7 December 2026.
Q: How do I pack my things?
A: You get two moving crates. Pack them by 16:00 on Wednesday 2 December. Label them with your name and your team's zone.
Q: How do I get a desk?
A: Riverside House has shared desks. You book them in the DeskBook app. Booking opens on Monday 30 November.
Q: Can I park at Riverside House?
A: Yes, there are 20 parking spaces. You book them in the DeskBook app. Four accessible spaces next to the entrance are kept for people who need them.
Q: Who do I ask if I have questions about the move?
A: Email the move team at move-team@example.com.
